update-channel.label: Mower Name
update-channel.description: Name displayed for the mower in Robonect. Accepts a new name as a command.

update-channel.label: Mower ID
update-channel.description: Identifier reported by the mower.

update-channel.label: Mower Time
update-channel.description: Current date and time reported by the Robonect clock.

update-channel.label: Reboot Robonect
update-channel.description: Send ON to restart the Robonect module. The WLAN connection is interrupted during the restart.

update-channel.label: Shut Down Robonect
update-channel.description: Send ON to shut down the Robonect module.

update-channel.label: Put Robonect to Sleep
update-channel.description: Send ON to put the Robonect module into standby.

update-channel.label: Garage Door Enabled
update-channel.description: Whether the optional garage-door system is enabled.

update-channel.label: Garage Door Position
update-channel.description: Position of the optional garage door: 0% open, 100% closed, 75% opening, and 25% closing. UP opens, DOWN closes, and STOP releases the door.

update-channel.label: Garage Door Arrested
update-channel.description: Whether the optional garage-door system reports that the door is arrested.

update-channel.label: Mower Battery Level
update-channel.description: Battery charge level as a percentage.

update-channel.label: WLAN Signal Quality
update-channel.description: Home-network signal quality, converted to a scale from 0 (weakest) to 4 (strongest).

update-channel.label: WLAN Signal Strength
update-channel.description: Received home-network signal strength in dBm.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN Enabled
update-channel.description: Whether Robonect is configured to connect to the home WLAN.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN SSID
update-channel.description: Network name of the home WLAN configured in Robonect.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN IP Address
update-channel.description: IP address of the Robonect home-network interface.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN MAC Address
update-channel.description: MAC address of the Robonect home-network interface.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN DHCP Client
update-channel.description: Whether the home-network interface obtains its IP configuration through DHCP.

update-channel.label: Gateway Ping Monitoring
update-channel.description: Whether gateway connection monitoring is enabled. Robonect pings the gateway every 30 seconds and reconnects the WLAN after three consecutive missed replies.

update-channel.label: Gateway Ping Time
update-channel.description: Gateway ping response time as text, including the unit supplied by Robonect.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN Netmask
update-channel.description: Subnet mask of the Robonect home-network interface.

update-channel.label: Home WLAN Gateway
update-channel.description: Gateway address used by the Robonect home-network interface.

update-channel.label: Access Point Enabled
update-channel.description: Whether the Robonect access point is enabled.

update-channel.label: Access Point SSID
update-channel.description: Network name broadcast by the Robonect access point.

update-channel.label: Access Point MAC Address
update-channel.description: MAC address of the Robonect access-point interface.

update-channel.label: Access Point Hidden
update-channel.description: Whether the access-point network name is hidden from WLAN scans.

update-channel.label: Access Point Radio Channel
update-channel.description: Radio channel configured for the access point. The setting applies only while Robonect is not connected to a home WLAN.

update-channel.label: Access Point Encryption
update-channel.description: Authentication and encryption mode reported for the access point.

update-channel.label: Access Point Client Limit
update-channel.description: Maximum number of clients allowed to connect to the access point.

update-channel.label: Access Point IP Address
update-channel.description: IP address of the Robonect access-point interface.

update-channel.label: Access Point Netmask
update-channel.description: Subnet mask of the Robonect access-point interface.

update-channel.label: Access Point Gateway
update-channel.description: Gateway address configured for the Robonect access-point interface.

update-channel.label: Access Point DHCP Server
update-channel.description: Whether the access point assigns IP addresses to connected clients through DHCP.

update-channel.label: Access Point DHCP Range Start
update-channel.description: First IP address in the access-point DHCP address pool.

update-channel.label: Access Point DHCP Range End
update-channel.description: Last IP address in the access-point DHCP address pool.

update-channel.label: Blade Motor Average
update-channel.description: Unscaled average diagnostic value reported for the blade motor.

update-channel.label: Blade Motor Speed
update-channel.description: Rotational speed of the blade motor.

update-channel.label: Blade Motor Current
update-channel.description: Electric current drawn by the blade motor.

update-channel.label: Total Running Time
update-channel.description: Total mower running time.

update-channel.label: Total Mowing Time
update-channel.description: Total time spent mowing.

update-channel.label: Total Charging-Station Search Time
update-channel.description: Total time spent searching for the charging station.

update-channel.label: Total Charging Time
update-channel.description: Total time spent charging.

update-channel.label: Full Charge Count
update-channel.description: Number of full battery charges.

update-channel.label: Recorded Error Count
update-channel.description: Number of errors recorded by the mower.

update-channel.label: Remote Portal Enabled
update-channel.description: Whether the mower.online remote-access service is enabled.

update-channel.label: Remote Portal Connected
update-channel.description: Whether Robonect is connected to the remote-access service.

update-channel.label: Remote Portal URL
update-channel.description: URL for remote access to the Robonect web interface; returned only while the remote service is connected.

update-channel.label: Remote Portal Host Name
update-channel.description: Host name reported for access through the remote-access service.

update-channel.label: Weather Mowing Pause
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service is currently preventing mowing.

update-channel.label: Weather Rain Intensity
update-channel.description: Current rain intensity reported by the weather service, as a percentage.

update-channel.label: Weather Temperature
update-channel.description: Current outdoor temperature reported by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Weather Relative Humidity
update-channel.description: Current relative air humidity reported by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Weather Daylight
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service currently reports daytime.

update-channel.label: Weather City
update-channel.description: City name resolved by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Weather City ID
update-channel.description: City identifier used to select the weather-service location. Accepts a non-negative integer.

update-channel.label: Weather Postal Code
update-channel.description: Postal code used to select the weather-service location. Sent as text to preserve leading zeroes.

update-channel.label: Weather Country
update-channel.description: Country returned for the weather-service location.

update-channel.label: Weather Sunrise
update-channel.description: Sunrise time returned by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Weather Sunset
update-channel.description: Sunset time returned by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Weather Icon URL
update-channel.description: Weather icon URL or URL template returned by the service, including any %s placeholder.

update-channel.label: Weather Observation Time
update-channel.description: Time of the weather data.

update-channel.label: Rain Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that rain prevents mowing.

update-channel.label: Cold Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that low temperature prevents mowing.

update-channel.label: Heat Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that high temperature prevents mowing.

update-channel.label: Dry-Air Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that low air humidity prevents mowing.

update-channel.label: Humid-Air Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that high air humidity prevents mowing.

update-channel.label: Daytime Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports an active daytime mowing restriction.

update-channel.label: Nighttime Restriction Active
update-channel.description: Whether the weather service reports an active nighttime mowing restriction.

update-channel.label: Weather Pause Remaining
update-channel.description: Remaining waiting time before mowing may resume after a weather event.

update-channel.label: Weather Service Enabled
update-channel.description: Enable or disable the weather service used by Robonect.

update-channel.label: Weather Update Interval
update-channel.description: Interval at which Robonect requests new data from the weather service.

update-channel.label: Maximum Rain Intensity
update-channel.description: Maximum rain intensity allowed before Robonect pauses mowing.

update-channel.label: Minimum Mowing Temperature
update-channel.description: Minimum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

update-channel.label: Maximum Mowing Temperature
update-channel.description: Maximum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

update-channel.label: Minimum Mowing Humidity
update-channel.description: Minimum relative air humidity allowed for mowing, where supported by the firmware.

update-channel.label: Maximum Mowing Humidity
update-channel.description: Maximum relative air humidity allowed for mowing.

update-channel.label: Prevent Daytime Mowing
update-channel.description: Prevent mowing during daytime as determined by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Prevent Nighttime Mowing
update-channel.description: Prevent mowing during nighttime as determined by the weather service.

update-channel.label: Push Service URL
update-channel.description: Destination URL for Robonect push-service requests.

update-channel.label: Push Service Username
update-channel.description: Username used to authenticate push-service requests.

update-channel.label: Push Service Password
update-channel.description: Write-only password for push-service authentication. Accepts a new password as a command; its state remains undefined and automatic state prediction is disabled.

update-channel.label: Push Service Interval
update-channel.description: Interval for cyclic push-service requests.

update-channel.label: Mower Operating Hours
update-channel.description: Accumulated mower operating hours.

update-channel.label: Mower Mode
update-channel.description: Operating mode: AUTO follows the timers, HOME remains in the charging station, MANUAL prepares the mower for a separate lawn, and EOD returns home until the next day. Distinguishing EOD from HOME in state updates requires the localized Ajax web-interface request enabled by ajaxUiScraping.

update-channel.label: Mower Start Release
update-channel.description: ON releases automatic starts and requests a start; OFF blocks automatic starts and requests a stop. The actual mower activity is shown by Mower Status.

update-channel.label: Mower Status
update-channel.description: Current mower activity, such as parking, mowing, searching, or charging.

update-channel.label: Mowing Prevention Code
update-channel.description: Raw code identifying the condition preventing mowing.

update-channel.label: Mower at Charging Station
update-channel.description: Whether the mower reports that it is at home in the charging station.

update-channel.label: Current Status Duration
update-channel.description: Time spent in the current mower status.

update-channel.label: Current Remote-Start Distance
update-channel.description: Distance travelled from the charging station while travelling to a remote-start point.

update-channel.label: Mowing Schedule Status
update-channel.description: Current mowing schedule state: inactive, active, or standby.

update-channel.label: Next Scheduled Start
update-channel.description: Next start time reported by the mower schedule.

update-channel.label: Mowing Job
update-channel.description: Send ON to start a mowing job using this channel configuration, or OFF to stop it. Active job detection uses the localized Ajax web-interface response when ajaxUiScraping is enabled; otherwise it uses the binding's tracked job state.

update-channel.label: Offline Timeout Event
update-channel.description: Reports the configured offline timeout. The current handler publishes OFFLINE_TIMEOUT as a state update; it does not emit a channel-trigger event.

update-channel.label: Reset Mower Error
update-channel.description: Send ON to reset the mower's current error state. This is an action and does not report whether an error is present.

update-channel.label: Current Error Code
update-channel.description: Manufacturer-defined code of the mower's current error.

update-channel.label: Current Error Message
update-channel.description: Description of the mower's current error.

update-channel.label: Current Error Time
update-channel.description: Date and time of the mower's current error.

update-channel.label: Last Recorded Error Code
update-channel.description: Manufacturer-defined code of the latest error in the mower's error history.

update-channel.label: Last Recorded Error Message
update-channel.description: Description of the latest error in the mower's error history.

update-channel.label: Last Recorded Error Time
update-channel.description: Date and time of the latest error in the mower's error history.

update-channel.label: Robonect Internal Temperature
update-channel.description: Temperature measured inside the Robonect module.

update-channel.label: Robonect Internal Humidity
update-channel.description: Relative humidity measured inside the Robonect module.

update-channel.label: Blade Remaining Quality
update-channel.description: Remaining blade quality estimated by Robonect, as a percentage.

update-channel.label: Blade Age
update-channel.description: Number of days since the blade replacement date recorded in Robonect.

update-channel.label: Blade Operating Time
update-channel.description: Accumulated blade operating time since the last replacement recorded in Robonect.

add-channel.label: Weather Service: Enabled
add-channel.description: Enable or disable the weather service used by Robonect.

add-channel.label: Weather Service: Update Interval
add-channel.description: Interval at which Robonect requests new data from the weather service.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Rain Intensity
add-channel.description: Maximum rain intensity allowed before Robonect pauses mowing.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Minimum Mowing Temperature
add-channel.description: Minimum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Mowing Temperature
add-channel.description: Maximum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Minimum Mowing Humidity
add-channel.description: Minimum relative air humidity allowed for mowing.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Mowing Humidity
add-channel.description: Maximum relative air humidity allowed for mowing.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Prevent Daytime Mowing
add-channel.description: Prevent mowing during daytime as determined by the weather service.

add-channel.label: Weather Config: Prevent Nighttime Mowing
add-channel.description: Prevent mowing during nighttime as determined by the weather service.
